lines.say: 7.4 billion tokens per month, and every single one of them comes from a free tier.
FreeLLMAPI stacks 34 free LLM providers behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Every serious AI lab now offers a free tier, but stacking them by hand is painful.
This router picks the highest-priority model with a healthy key that is still under all its rate limits.
If that provider fails, the request moves down the fallback chain to the next free model.
Provider keys stay encrypted, and the whole thing runs locally, single-user by design.
The catalog tracks 474 model families across 635 free provider endpoints.
It idles at about 40 MB of memory and runs anywhere Node 20+ runs, even on a Raspberry Pi.
Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Aider and many more agents can point straight at it.
To start, run the one-line install script with Docker, open localhost port 3001, and add your keys.
Know the trade-offs: no frontier models, variable latency, and it is meant for personal experimentation only.
Save this for your next side project that needs an LLM but has no budget.
